_note: SYNTHETIC data (CLAUDE.md §4.1, D-04). Alarm instances (site, inverter id, timestamp, message wording) are invented for the prototype. Fault codes referenced are real, drawn from the Sungrow SG150CX manual (data/raw/SOURCES.md) so retrieval can be checked against real source text. `category` is a labelling convenience matching config/requirements.yaml's fault_categories keys, not part of the alarms DB schema in CLAUDE.md §9. `answerable` is the D-14 eval ground truth: whether the manual genuinely contains evidence covering this alarm's mandatory requirements. Alarms 11-12 use code 9001 and category battery_thermal_event_test, a synthetic/test fault category (see config/requirements.yaml) deliberately unsatisfiable against this manual, so the eval set has real unanswerable cases to check abstention against — not just answerable ones.
